Interface PushInstruction

All Superinterfaces:
StackProducer
All Known Subinterfaces:
ConstantPushInstruction
All Known Implementing Classes:
ACONST_NULL, ALOAD, BIPUSH, DCONST, DLOAD, DUP, DUP2, FCONST, FLOAD, GETSTATIC, ICONST, ILOAD, LCONST, LDC, LDC_W, LDC2_W, LLOAD, LoadInstruction, SIPUSH
public interface PushInstruction extends StackProducer
Denotes an unparameterized instruction to produce a value on top of the stack, such as ILOAD, LDC, SIPUSH, DUP, ICONST, etc.
